Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: landscape 3:2 project preview banner for Kvasir, a music bot.
Input image 1 is the photographic composition and turntable design reference. Input image 2 is ONLY a reference for the vivid green iris pattern to integrate into the record.
Create a refined photorealistic product photograph adapted from image 1 into a wide 3:2 banner. Strict straight-down 90-degree overhead camera. Preserve the clean ivory/off-white rectangular vintage turntable, matte warm golden-yellow studio backdrop, strong graphic simplicity, natural hard-edged cast shadow, and bold close crop. The large circular vinyl occupies the left two-thirds, intentionally cropped by the left edge; its center spindle remains visible. The deck's right edge and clean yellow negative space are visible at the right.
The vinyl playing surface must be a flat emerald-green iris picture disc: intricate radial fibers, deep emerald outer rim and luminous acid-lime interior drawn from image 2, with fine realistic concentric vinyl grooves over the iris texture. Clearly a flat playable vinyl disc, never a literal eyeball. Small plain dark center label and a tiny silver spindle; no eye white, eyelids or lashes.
Use exactly ONE slim STRAIGHT dark metal tonearm, inspired by the simple geometry in image 1: a single smooth tube running diagonally from a minimal compact pivot in the upper-right of the deck down-left to a small solid rectangular black cartridge. Position its stylus on the INNER green grooves close to the center label, not on the outer edge, not on the label. Simplify the upper-right pivot/support to a low circular base, one small smooth joint and a modest counterweight. No complex stacked rings, extra levers, exposed wires or clusters of knobs. Keep the hardware coherent and legible at thumbnail size.
High-end editorial still life, realistic materials and photographic lighting, crisp clean silhouette. No lettering, logos, labels, captions, watermark, invented UI, added waveform or extra objects. Preserve the reference's warm yellow/ivory visual character while the brilliant green iris record provides the focal point. Deliver one finished wide 3:2 banner.
